chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, and Ibrahim ibn Maymun was with us in Medina that year, he said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Our companions are residing in Mecca, and they ask me: if I come to them, what should they do?' He said: 'Tell them: when the crescent of Dhul-Hijjah appears, let them go out to al-Tan'eem, let them enter the state of ihram, and let them perform tawaf around the House and between al-Safa and al-Marwah. Then let them perform tawaf again and conclude with the talbiyah at each tawaf.'
Then he said: 'As for you, enjoy (perform Tamattu') during the months of Hajj, and enter the state of ihram on the Day of Tarwiyah from al-Masjid al-Haram.'

key_terms.إِحْرَامٌ: The ritual state of consecration entered by pilgrims before performing Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةِ: The recitation of 'Labbayk Allahumma labbayk' upon entering ihram
key_terms.التَّنْعِيمِ: A miqat (ritual boundary) located near Mecca, used for entering the state of ihram
key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةُ: Two small hills between which pilgrims walk during the sa'i ritual
key_terms.تَمَتَّعْ: To perform Umrah al-Tamattu', a type of Hajj where Umrah and Hajj are performed separately
key_terms.ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: The eighth month of the Islamic calendar, during which Hajj rituals begin
key_terms.طَوَافٌ: The ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The 8th day of Dhul-Hijjah, when pilgrims proceed to Mina

ai.seo_question: What is the difference in performing Umrah for residents of Mecca versus visitors according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith, cited in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, establishes the distinct miqat protocols for Meccan residents performing Umrah al-Mufradah from al-Tan'eem versus the narrator performing Umrah al-Tamattu' from the Masjid al-Haram. It highlights the scholarly consensus on the necessity of concluding each tawaf with the talbiyah, a detail often debated in fiqh regarding the completeness of the ritual act. The distinction underscores the practical application of Hajj rituals based on one's place of residence and the specific type of Hajj being performed.
